tasks.title: GPU YARA acceleration (carried over from SHARED_CONTEXT task table)
tasks.notes: TASK-010 id was previously reserved in SHARED_CONTEXT.md but never queued — formalizing it here. Run after TASK-017 lands (same pool plumbing). | DEFERRED v29.43e (agent-audit-007): yara-python has no GPU execution model — rules compile to a CPU VM, so there is nothing to offload to CUDA. Real GPU acceleration would require a custom matcher (e.g. Hyperscan/regex-CUDA port) plus a rule translator; out of scope for this codebase. The perf win claimed in the original task is not achievable by passing yara scans to the existing gpu_executor. Machine HAS an RTX 3050 (verified via gpu_detector_fix) — the gap is software, not hardware.

tasks.title: SECURITY/RELIABILITY: Unify 3 quarantine formats — AES-GCM + signed manifest + write-ahead + hash-verified restore + boot reconciliation
tasks.notes: Audit section 9: mitigate() quarantine is a plain shutil.move with collision overwrite (:9791-9810); remediation XOR(0x5A) is not encryption (:954-979); system_cleanup restore (:121-138) never verifies hash, never restores DACLs, and marks restored=1 even when the file is missing. One quarantine service: AES-GCM with DPAPI-protected key, manifest written BEFORE original delete (write-ahead), restore re-hashes before touching the original path, boot-time reconciliation of orphans. | IMPLEMENTED v29.42x: new quarantine_core.py — AES-256-GCM (DPAPI-protected key, XOR-0x5A fallback when cryptography/win32crypt unavailable; chunked 8B-nonce-prefix + 4B-counter construction, constant memory), write-ahead manifest + self-verified encrypted copy BEFORE original delete, collision-safe dest naming, tamper-refusing hash-verified restore (temp + os.replace), legacy XOR .meta.json sidecar support, manifest-less .locked raw restore with caller-supplied hash. Wired into: advanced_threat_remediation._quarantine_file, main mitigate() quarantine branch, _remediation_revert (was a SILENT NO-OP — it scanned ~/downpour_quarantine for a *.quar suffix no producer ever wrote; now manifest lookup by original path across both quarantine roots), system_cleanup.restore_quarantined_files (hash-verified, restored=2 = evidence lost). threat_response_center/dashboard quarantine buttons are UI stubs — no change needed. 146/146 tests (7 new in tests/test_quarantine_core.py). REMAINING follow-ups: boot-time reconciliation scan + DACLs on the quarantine dir. | FOLLOW-UPS IMPLEMENTED v29.42z: reconcile_quarantine() (manifest/content cross-check: orphan manifests, unmanifested content, legacy .locked census; optional DB pass marks rows with missing content restored=2) + harden_quarantine_dacl() (icacls with language-neutral SIDs *S-1-5-18/*S-1-5-32-544, inheritance disabled, elevated-only with per-process attempt guard; auto-invoked on first quarantine per dir); wired into system_cleanup (reconcile runs before restore in --auto/--restore flows, plus a dedicated --reconcile flag) and a quarantine_core CLI (--reconcile/--db/--harden-dacl). 158/158 tests (4 new). | V2-MERGED v29.43b: agent-audit-001 shipped quarantine_core v2 (QuarantineService, SQLite-tracked QuarantineEntry, per-file security-descriptor preservation); agent-audit-007 rewired all 4 call sites (remediation engine, main mitigate, _remediation_revert, system_cleanup) + rewrote tests. OPEN: legacy-format migration, GUI .quar producer (main:~55285), possible v2 safe_name collision. 171/171 tests. | v29.43c: collision CONFIRMED and FIXED (timestamp suffix on clash) + legacy migration SHIPPED (migrate_legacy_entries: v1 AES/XOR sidecars hash-verified + plain .locked/.quar, originals renamed .migrated) wired into system_cleanup. Residual: GUI .quar producer. 175/175 tests. | V29.43D FINAL RESIDUAL CLOSED: the GUI producer _threats_quarantine_selected (main:~55285) migrated from plain .quar shutil.move to the quarantine service (AES-GCM + manifest + DACL preservation, entry-id shown in the UI); vault message points at downpour_data/quarantine/locked. ALL quarantine producers now unified — single format, single service. | V29.43G: migration over-scan fixed (extension allowlist .quarantined/.locked/.quar — the scan no longer renames the service key/DB as legacy artifacts). | V29.43J: migration now STREAMS (constant memory end-to-end — fixes the same RAM-blowup class as v29.43e in the migration path) + fixed latent TypeError in the legacy-AES key lookup. 205/205 tests.
